issues.text: Larger historical lake versus 650 x 700 m reserved cove: review full lake scope before regional shoreline work.
All elevation, pad and water heights here are proposed; they are not recovered source measurements.
New tidal channels make a continuous boat corridor; review their visual/geographic fit before final grading.
Wet walking crossings, major grades and some building entrances still require bridge/landing/step design.
Sky anchors are horizontal projections only; altitude, arrival and fall handling are not decided.
Bedroom is a local dimensional test; its final wing/floor placement and balcony structural supports are not solved.
Long regional routes remain optional corridors. Short local loops and proposed transfers do not implement a fast-travel system.

regions.name: Royal terraces and rose gardens
regions.landform: Gentle garden shoulders outside the palace pad; drainage swales and terraced approaches remain to engineer.
regions.status: Proposed landform recipe; palace-front architecture remains GEN-37.

regions.name: Freshwater banks and sheltered lagoon
regions.landform: Low basin margins and gentle wet-to-dry banks; fresh lake and tidal lagoon retain separate levels.
regions.status: Larger historical lake extent and engineered raised shores remain unresolved.

regions.name: Open coast, dunes and reef margins
regions.landform: An irregular open coast, low dune packets, headlands and sheltered mouths; no enclosing mountain ring.
regions.status: Wave/reef geometry and detailed shoreline contacts follow route review.

regions.name: Jade jungle and wetland pockets
regions.landform: Humid hummocks, shallow swales and low wetland pockets near the temple; keep the river outlet clear.
regions.status: Species/rigs and wetland water-level decisions require regional review.

regions.name: Three woodland districts and meadow edges
regions.landform: Soft woodland ridges, mossy hollows and open clearings, using the saved forest polygons.
regions.status: FC05 receives placement/clearance prototypes; other districts have recipes only.

regions.name: Local fjord highlands and misty ridges
regions.landform: Localized northwest and northeast ridge fingers with open saddles and shallow approach valleys.
regions.status: Vertical access, cliff contacts and regional grading are still proposals.

regions.name: Canyon, gullies and crescent arch coast
regions.landform: A localized eroded gully with broad shoulders and dry ledges; the natural arch remains a tidal exception.
regions.status: Hero arch contacts and safe ledge routes require separate geometry.

regions.name: Sky-island substrates
regions.landform: Separate elevated island shells, meadow/garden surfaces and contained edges.
fauna: luminous insects; optional magical species subject to review
regions.status: XZ projections retained; no altitude, terrain shell or arrival/return implementation.
